releases.displayName: Wings Of Bluestar gets its first update in 8 months

items.text: Hi pilots, long time not seen!

Since the last update, which was around December 2023, both the game engine and Steam did get a lot of patches and updates. Unfortunately, these changes do not bring greatness to old game, but rather bugs. Which is the case for Wings Of Bluestar.

For a solo indie developer like myself, 4 years is an eternity. Only big studios can afford patching and keeping games up to date for many years. However, I'm back and I'll be fixing the game. I spent the whole day trying to make the game launches on the newest game engine, which is the first step towards my goal.
The biggest bug the game encountered is the gamepads no longer supported. It wasn't my fault, but Steams. They included a new gamepads system, which broke the old one. But I fixed it.
Another major bug I did fix in this patch are the crushes on both stage 6 and stage 8.
The game exit message refusing to close.
The game always selects player 1 despite player 2 being selected.

And others I can't remember.: There are still a few minor bugs that I'll be slowly fixing. Yep, slowly, because I have two new games I'm working on. Like some broken achievements and some issues with occasional weird player respawns.: With that said, please let me know if there are still major and game breaking bugs, so I can take care of them. Those are my priority right now.: PS: if you liked Wings Of Bluestar, please make sure to check my newest shmup "Shockwave Triggers". A demo is already available on Steam. It's a vertical pixel art shmup. I do appreciate all types of support.
Hello pilots!
This is another regular update, in which a few bugs are fixed.

As a few may have noticed, the game was released on consoles 12 days ago (Yeay). And this was a perfect opportunity to get more people to try it out and in the process, some new bugs where reported, as well as new feedbacks.
After finishing work on the console version, I moved to this version and implemented a few fixes.
Thanks again for the support pilots! have a nice day!
Shinu is out (resuming work on my new game project...)
Hey there pilots!

notes.title: Here are the fixes that come with this update

items.text: 1 - Pause menu eventual bug during story mode.
2 - Ship 2 loses the ability to charge after killing a boss and charging during the result menu.
3 - Boss 1 death no longer soft locks the game.
4 - Power ups and other items scrolling is fixed to match the stages.
PS: technical explanation for most of these bugs for people interested in coding:

As a few of you know, the game was made in an old engine GMS 1.4. Then ported to a newer engine (at that time) GMS 2 when it was around 90% done. All worked fine till an update in the engine changed some vital functions, one of them is that the engine now stores all values of the game, as long as it is running, without the need of a save system. This wasn't the case in the version in which the game was built; the old version doesn't save anything unless it's part of the save system the developer creates.
Due to this update, a lot of bugs did happen. And the majority of bugs reported by you guys are related to this issue. I'll keep doing my best to fix all of them.
This is a random portrait of the character from my new games, she does look like Aya Morobito and the games share the same world :)

releases.displayName: Regular Game Update And Bug Fixes

items.text: Hey Pilots! long time not seen.
Sorry for the lack of regular updates, but I have some technical issues with the game engine.
In order to work on the game I need to use an engine that is by 2022/2023 standards outdated. I can't use the recent version of the engine because they removed/changed a lot of functionalities.

This wouldn't be an issue if it wasn't for the old engine now broken and the developers won't fix it because, obviously, it's outdated. The big issue I'm having with it is that it won't save anything done to the project and I have to put a lot of work just to make it save and compile. Hence it's now taking me a lot of time to fix bugs.

notes.title: However, I managed to fix a few recently, here is the list

items.text: Ship 2 (Altair) not showing at stage 3.
Stage 3 brakes if the player restarts it.
Boss timers no longer loop.

notes.title: Issues that player thought are bugs

items.text: No start/pause menu during the visual novel mode: I didn't add one because those are short and player can always use the auto text option to skip fast to shmup gameplay. If in need of pausing, the player can just stop playing, the story mode won't progress.
Some choices in the story mode are gray and have no select arrow: Those need a certain circumstance to be available, player mostly needs to clear the story once to get access to those.

notes.title: Other bugs that I couldn't duplicate

items.text: Boss Rush crashes the game: Works fine on my end.: Other than that, the outdated engine is still giving troubles to work with and the game may get some new bugs. Please bear with me and keep reporting them, I'll do my best to fix them.: Thanks a lot for the support pilots and happy celebrations!: Shinu

Hello there pilots!
Here's a new update, something I've been asked a lot in forums, Twitter and Discord:
The game now has an auto fire button, which allows you to keep firing without entering the slow focus mode. And like the other keys, it's mappable (hope this is a real English word lol).

The other added feature is Extend. Now you are rewarded with an extra life. The extend isn't score based like most shmups, but comes as a reward drop item at the start of stage 5, as long as you are playing normal difficulty or above. So, just survive till stage 5 and you'll get it.

As for the optimization project, it's not done yet, still needs a lot of work since it will include more graphic settings for those with high end PCs. However, this update includes a little optimization and I hope it shows some results.
With that said, I'll be back t work. Looking forward to your feedback, bug reports and suggestions.
Shinu Real Arts
Hi there pilots,
I managed to improve the performance for Windows 10 users.

Now, stage 1 no longer have major stutters. The issue was during porting the game from the old engine (GMS 1.4) to the newer one (GMS2). While it fixed graphical issues like glitches and window blinking, it create the new texture loading bug, which made the game stutter a lot in stage 1, because it has to load assets during gameplay.
Another addition to this build is also the new controller icons for PS4 and X1.
I'm not done with optimization though, I'll keep working on the game and making it even better, while counting on your feedback and bug reports.
Cheers,
Shinu

notes.title: Here is what we've achieved so far

items.text: Bonus Menu: Now you have different features to in-lock via the game shop.

Game shop: Now the game had a game shop, in which you spend the Risk Points collected throughout the game in order to unlock bonus features like the Sound Test, the Gallery, the Trophies menu, the Boss Rush mode and most importantly, buy extra credits to add to your continues.

Sound Test mode: Now the game has a sound test mode, in which you can enjoy all original soundtracks made by our awesome composer Big Impact Sound. As well as being able to listen to all sound effects.

Gallery mode: The Gallery Mode is by far the most interesting bonus menu, at least in our opinion, since it's filled with artworks to enjoy; from original game artworks, sketches, concept arts to fanarts made by the games' awesome fans (they are credited in the game of course :).: With this huge step finally done, it's time to work on what's left from the bonus features, namely the Boss Rush mode and adding the rest of trophies to the games.: Back to work. And again, stay safe pilots!!: Cheers,: Shinu Real
